title: MC Gear Rising:Revengence
description:
This pack is made for EpicFight and Weapons of Miracles.
Replaces the default weapons into some main mgrr weapons.
body:
[Minecraft Gear Rising;Revengence]
Another resourcepack based on EpicFight and Wepaons of Miracles.
This resourcepack is made to bring Mgrr(Metal Gear Rising:Revengence) experience to minecraft.
Currently this pack adds the following weapons:


Hf Murasama(Satsujin from wom)



Hf Blade(Uchigatana from EF)


Polearm(Nethertie Staff from wom)


Pincer blade/Bloodlust(Diamond sword from Minecraft)


Dual Pincer Blade(Netherite Sword from Minecraft)


Dystopia(Netherite Dagger from EF)

Requirements: Minecraft 1.20.1, EpicFht, Weapons of Miracles all latest.


Credits:
Thanks to all the creators of Bdhill Reforge the sword edge. Checkout this pack also:https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/epic-fight-bd-hill-reforge-the-sword-edge

Thanks OnixTheCat for creating the hf murasama pack:https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/otc-murasama


Thanks to all the creators of Mgrr(Mine Gear Rising:Revengence):https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mgrr



My wrok is very little just like changing model positions and combining them all. It wouldn't be possible without their hardwork. Make sure you support them.
Recomended to be used with EpicFight-Extra
